title: Retrieval-evaluation golden judgements
description: Validates judgements.yaml (parsed to JSON) at a frozen fixture corpus root (Phase A, docs/roadmap.md). Each entry judges the expected results of one query. Whether every `queryId` names a query declared in queries.yaml, and whether every `itemId` in `relevant` or `forbidden` exists in the corpus manifest.yaml's migrations build, are the loader's to verify (S2).

queryId.description: The `id` of the query in queries.yaml this entry judges.

relevant.description: Items the harness expects the query to retrieve.

evidence.description: Source anchors the harness expects a correct answer to cite.

forbidden.description: Items that must never appear in the query's results — the superseded-knowledge and disclosure-equality error classes.

expectAbstention.description: Whether the correct answer is no answer. `true` contradicts a non-empty `relevant` list — see the constraint below.

itemId.description: The `itemId` published on a `knowledge.search` result (schemas/knowledge/retrieval-result.schema.json), which is what the loader matches a judgement against.

sourceUri.description: The evidence source anchor's URI the harness expects a correct answer to cite.

filePath.description: Optional file path narrowing the source anchor to one file within it.
